topic: Can oblique projection in beam coverage impact inter-cell interference differently than orthographic projection in GEO satellites?
response: Yes, oblique projection in beam coverage can impact inter-cell interference differently than orthographic projection in GEO satellites due to the varying angular selectivity and non-ideal spatial filtering by the satellite antenna. The angle between the selected user's position and the central line of the corresponding beam affects the interference strength.
reference_context: The reference context discusses multibeam satellite systems, spectrum reuse, and interbeam interference in GEO satellites. It highlights the use of oblique projection, which makes the bottom of the cone similar to an ellipse, affecting cell shape and angular selectivity.
